correctness.rationale: Square signed increments have zero integral circulation for all target lengths except 4, and both rim winds agree. The difference of cochains gives integral heights; same winding and target parity suffice for a legal height lift. An acyclicity and monotone recoloring argument proves each nonextreme winding-parity fiber connected. Fujii et al. Theorem 5.1 proves these components circles. Extremal winds yield 4q genuinely isolated maps, and q=4 folds onto K2. Independent finite enumeration and component checks pass 19 parameter pairs; all-parameter conclusions rest on proof.

value.rationale: The exact classification covers all prism-source and cycle-target sizes and distinguishes three genuinely different regimes: odd targets have one circle per nonextreme winding, even targets at least six have two due to parity, and the square target folds to contractible components; boundary divisibility creates precisely 4q isolated homomorphisms.
